Share.d:
Do a chop chop motion (like this) to toggle your flashlight.

If you want you can also import this project and that will allow you to hear received SMS out loud if you do the chop chop motion up to 10 seconds after you receive the message.

Note 1: you may need to go into Tasker Preferences and calibrate your Accelerometer in the "Monitor" tab, at the bottom to make it work reliably.

Note 2: In the same Preferences screen you can enable this to work with the screen off by turning on the Accelerometer setting under "Display Off Monitoring"

Network Speed - shows Network Speed and daily data usage as notification. On Tapping Notification a ui will be opened with App Stats and Daily Stats.

Network Speed will run only if Network is Connected and Display is Unlocked. Enable all profiles.

Share.d:
Send a WhatsApp message to someone that is not on your contact list.

Add as a Home Screen widget for easy access.

Normally you need to add someone as a contact before you can send them a message. This way you can simply send the message right away!

Check out the video device here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6o5sHtvUrxU
